records.sql: SELECT 'ORA-' || LPAD(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(MESSAGE_TEXT),'ORA-([0-9]{1,5})([^0-9]|$)',1,1,'c',1),5,'0') AS code FROM V$DIAG_ALERT_EXT WHERE ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-06 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(MESSAGE_TEXT),'ORA-[0-9]{1,5}([^0-9]|$)') ORDER BY ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP DESC, RECORD_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM V$DIAG_INCIDENT WHERE CREATE_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-06 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND CREATE_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM')

SELECT i.INCIDENT_ID AS incident_id, p.PROBLEM_KEY AS problem_key FROM V$DIAG_INCIDENT i JOIN V$DIAG_PROBLEM p ON p.PROBLEM_ID=i.PROBLEM_ID AND p.CON_ID=i.CON_ID WHERE i.CREATE_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-06 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND i.CREATE_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') ORDER BY i.CREATE_TIME DESC, i.INCIDENT_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
